Standard-target baseline for the study targets above (MDC2025ba_st*): the same CE settings, standard geometry geom_run1_a.txt, and the standard Run 1A stop pool MuminusStopsCat.MDC2025ac (from TargetStops.MDC2025ac: 4e9 draws, prescale 1000, 1.44M stops). The stop pool predates StageNormalization; MDC2025ba's TargetStopResampler read it without error in the 2026-10-29 MuStopPileup no-IPA runs. Its only copy is on tape.

Run 1A high-energy muon-capture protons for Michael MacKenzie's request (2026-10): stops from MuminusStopsCat.MDC2025ac with the geom_run1_a override all Run1A primaries carry; filter keeps the defaults except MinimumSumCaloStepE 20 (matches Run 1B). Smoke at MDC2025bb 2026-11-03: 2.25% pass, VmHWM 2527 MB (above the 2500MB default, hence 3000MB). Sizing matches Run 1B: 200 x 500k draws. Output on disk: it is the one-file-per-job input of the Mix1BB entry in mix.json.

Run 1A calo-pointed muon-capture neutrons, same setup and request as MuCapProtonTail above. Smoke at MDC2025bb 2026-11-03: 6.3% pass (627 of 10k draws), VmHWM 2540 MB, so 3000MB like the proton entry (user decision). Sizing matches Run 1B: 1000 x 125k draws.
